tools.name: tip_bill_split
tools.description: Split a bill across a group after tax, tip, and optional rounding. Returns each person's share, the tip, the effective tip rate, and the collected total.

tools.name: discount_percent_off
tools.description: Compute the final checkout total after stacked percentage discounts, a fixed coupon, and a tax assumption. Sequential discounts are NOT additive.

tools.name: bmi
tools.description: Calculate body mass index and category from weight and height in US units.

tools.name: bmr_tdee
tools.description: Estimate basal metabolic rate (Mifflin-St Jeor) and total daily energy expenditure from age, weight, height, sex, and an activity multiplier.

tools.name: mortgage_payment
tools.description: Estimate the full monthly housing payment (principal, interest, tax, insurance, PMI, HOA) and the total interest over the term. Requires a positive home price.

tools.name: auto_loan
tools.description: Estimate a monthly auto-loan payment from price, down payment, trade-in, term, and APR.

tools.name: compound_interest
tools.description: Grow a balance with compound interest and optional monthly contributions. Returns future value, total contributed, and interest earned.

tools.name: savings_growth
tools.description: Project the future value of a lump-sum investment (optionally with monthly additions), including interest earned.

tools.name: simple_interest
tools.description: Compute simple interest, total value, and a comparison to annual compounding.

tools.name: calorie
tools.description: Estimate BMR and total daily energy expenditure using Mifflin-St Jeor, from weight/height in US units.

tools.name: percentage
tools.description: Solve percentage problems: what is X% of Y, X is what % of Y, or the % change from X to Y.

tools.name: square_footage
tools.description: Compute total area (and with-waste area) from up to two rectangular spaces, plus square yards, square metres, and acres.

tools.name: apy
tools.description: Compute annual percentage yield from a nominal rate and a compounding frequency, plus the one year interest and ending balance on an example deposit.

tools.name: win_loss_percentage
tools.description: Compute a winning percentage from wins, losses, and ties, where ties count as half a win.

tools.name: slope
tools.description: Compute slope from rise and run as degrees, percent grade, and the rise to run ratio. Run must be above zero.

tools.name: rule_of_72
tools.description: Estimate the doubling time of money at a fixed rate using the rule of 72, plus the exact doubling time from the compound formula. Rate must be between 0 and 30 percent.

tools.name: cagr
tools.description: Compute the compound annual growth rate connecting a starting and an ending value over a number of years, with total return percent and absolute change.

tools.name: remainder
tools.description: Compute the remainder and floored quotient of a division. Works for decimal inputs, not just integers.

tools.name: combinations
tools.description: Compute the number of distinct combinations, n choose r, using a multiplicative form that avoids factorial overflow.

tools.name: margin_of_error
tools.description: Compute the margin of error for a survey sample at the 90, 95, or 99 percent confidence level, assuming maximum variance proportions.

tools.name: va_mortgage
tools.description: Monthly VA loan payment including the funding fee, with no PMI. Returns the financed amount, payment, and total interest.

tools.name: gross_rent_multiplier
tools.description: Gross rent multiplier for a rental property: price divided by annual gross rent. Lower means more rent per dollar of price.

tools.name: emergency_fund
tools.description: Emergency fund target (expenses times coverage months), the remaining gap versus current savings, and months to close the gap at a fixed monthly contribution.

tools.name: dividend_reinvestment
tools.description: Compound a portfolio with a constant dividend yield and price growth, reinvesting monthly and optionally adding deposits. Returns ending value, total contributed, and dividends reinvested.

tools.name: budget_50_30_20
tools.description: Split monthly after-tax income by the 50/30/20 rule into needs, wants, and savings or debt paydown.

tools.name: growing_degree_day
tools.description: Accumulate growing, heating, or cooling degree days (Fahrenheit basis) from daily high, low, a base threshold, and a day count. Includes Celsius-basis totals.

tools.name: insulation
tools.description: U-value of an insulation upgrade and an estimated annual heating saving from conduction, using heating degree days, area, kWh conversion, and utility cost.

tools.name: roofing
tools.description: Roof area from footprint and pitch, with waste allowance, roofing squares, and approximate shingle bundles (3 per square).

tools.name: maintenance_calories
tools.description: Daily maintenance calories (TDEE) from Mifflin-St Jeor BMR and an activity level, using metric inputs.

tools.name: protein_molecular_weight
tools.description: Estimate a protein chain molecular weight in Da and kDa from residue count and average residue mass, plus peptide bond count.

tools.name: key_transposition
tools.description: Transpose a musical key and report the number of semitone steps upward between two keys.

tools.name: audio_time_stretch
tools.description: Compute the new duration of audio at a playback speed, plus the percent time change.

tools.name: youtube_revenue
tools.description: Estimated YouTube Adsense revenue from monthly views and RPM, with an annual figure and a 30 percent RPM swing range. RPM defaults to 2 when omitted.

tools.name: ceiling_tile
tools.description: Count 2x2 ft ceiling tiles needed for a rectangular room, with room area and a 5 percent cut-waste reminder.

tools.name: boat_loan
tools.description: Boat or RV loan payment with optional sales tax, down payment, and trade-in, including amount financed and total interest.

tools.name: pressure
tools.description: Compute pressure in Pascals, kilopascals, and psi from a force in newtons over an area in square metres.
